caption: ad The hidden restaurants you NEED to know about ❤️ You guys know we love sharing hidden gems around London and these restaurants are exactly that - hidden away and absolute gems! You can get 50% off food at ALL OF THESE restaurants if you book them through @firsttableuk and it’s only £3 to book your first “First Table” when you sign up with code EXPLORING - book for 2-4 people at an off-peak dining time and get rewarded with 50% off the food bill (drinks are a regular price). It’s a no brainer. 🧠 SAVE THIS for hidden restaurants, all with 50% off food: ✨ La Nonna in Market Row, Brixton for delicious artisan pasta ✨ MBER London, underground on Pudding Lane for incredible pan-Asian sharing plates ✨ The Life Goddess for beautiful Greek dishes  ✨ The Laughing Yak Nepalese kitchen tucked away in Market Peckham  ✨ Sycamore Restaurant for seasonal Italian plates inside Middle Eighty Hotel in Covent Garden ✨ Tokii London, East meets West inside The Prince Akatoki London Hotel in Marylebone  ✨ Kiaans Tooting pan-Asian inside Tooting Market ✨ Jones Family Kitchen - hidden inside Eccleston Yards in Belgravia ❤️ Which one are you checking out first? #firsttable #halfpricefood #londonrestaurants #hiddenlondon #londonguide
